source.title: DMC to Glass Bead Conversion (Product #CCB)
source.publisher: Mill Hill, a division of Wichelt Imports, Inc.
source.transcriptionMethod: Transcribed by hand from the rendered pages of the PDF, checked against its text layer, every row in chart order. Trailing care markers (• and *) are dropped from names; codes, names, and DMC numbers are otherwise kept as printed.
source.runtimePolicy: The application reads only the committed normalized asset; it never fetches the source PDF.

sources: Seed (11/0), petite (15/0), size 8, size 6 and size 3 pebble diameters are from 123stitch.com's Mill Hill product listings.
Magnifica has no published Mill Hill diameter; it uses the Miyuki Delica 11/0 cylinder (1.6 mm) as the analogue.
The petite (15/0) figure is disputed: other sellers list 15/0 seed beads at 1.5 mm.
Lengths along the hole have no Mill Hill figure; they are typical proportions: 0.7 × diameter for round rocailles and 0.8 × for the Magnifica cylinder, after the Delica 11/0 (1.6 × 1.3 mm).

rules: Keep only the round series: Glass Seed, Antique Glass, Crayon Seed, Frosted Glass, Petite Glass, Size 3 Pebble, Size 6, Size 8, Magnifica. Bugle sections are excluded.
Exclude rows whose DMC column is X (replaced and potpourri beads).
Map the chart spelling Wht. to DMC Blanc; every other DMC code must match a DMC catalog code.
Take each bead colour from its mapped DMC record in catalog/dmc-colors.json.
Reject unknown series, malformed codes, duplicate bead codes, and DMC codes the DMC catalog lacks.

status.description: Each bead colour is the screen approximation of the DMC thread Mill Hill maps it to; it is not a measurement of the bead. Mill Hill notes that the DMC mapping can vary with dye lots.
